name: deepmerge
description: A library for deep (recursive) merging of Javascript objects (vendored copy of the official 4.3.1 release with a single prototype-poisoning guard — see PATCH.md)

_vendored.reason: CVE-2026-93753 / GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4 has no upstream patched release; this is a minimal, auditable local fix.
_vendored.basedOn: deepmerge@4.3.1 (official npm release), verbatim except the getKeys() guard documented in PATCH.md
_vendored.change: getKeys() filters an own "__proto__" key before enumeration; no other behavioral change.
_vendored.usedBy: transitive dependency of workbox-build via @rollup/plugin-node-resolve; wired through the root package.json "overrides" field.
